first_assessment_role: Failed and now explicitly exposed development. The original formal discovery and confirmation data remain protected.
training_data_policy: Every development and both assessment factor populations are excluded from training, including symmetry orbits. No failed assessment row is used as a training example.

phases.name: second_neighbor_refinement
phases.training_corpus: Existing corpus plus disjoint neighbors of eleven newly exposed failure factor orbits

teacher.condition: Use the teacher distribution only when its predicted candidate is exactly valid on that training example.

selection: Minimum of twenty-seven development accuracies, then their mean, over initial/raw/EMA checkpoints at scheduled evaluations.

readout_comparison.rule: Merge selected linear combination into the ordinary head and evaluate natively.

formal_study: Only after replacement independent assessment passes every stated accuracy criterion, run the previously registered study with its fixed hypotheses and controls.
causal_scope: This is an adaptive training continuation, not a matched estimate of the separate effects of teacher regularization and new training data.
